title: Reject DAO time values whose float/deadline arithmetic overflows
description: Correctness review finding in python/src/lichen/rpl/dao_manager.py lines 161-173, 245-254, and 946-991: math.isfinite() on an arbitrary huge int raises raw OverflowError, and finite large now/duration inputs can overflow now + lifetime*unit or freshness-retention arithmetic to infinity. That installs never-expiring/non-finite route timestamps despite the finite-time contract. Catch numeric conversion overflow and validate every computed deadline/retention timestamp before committing state; add extreme-number tests.
